facts.text: ROSWorld(sim_only=True) skips rospy.init_node, connects a PyBullet client, switches real-time simulation off and builds PBPerception and PBController
ROSWorld sets PyBullet's real-time simulation to 0 for its client
ROSWorld loads the PR2 from the models directory with a fixed base and places its base link at the origin
ROSWorld.stop resets the simulation, removing bodies and constraints, and disconnects the client
execute_motor_control selects motor control in command_torso and rest_for_duration, and is read again for every waypoint of follow_trajectory
get_joint_positions and set_joint_positions read and set the named joints of the robot through pybullet_tools
command_torso always sets the torso lift joint position kinematically, and also calls control_joint with the same position when execute_motor_control is true

follow_trajectory steps the simulation through joint_controller_hold2 for each waypoint when execute_motor_control is true, up to max_sim_duration simulated seconds per waypoint, and otherwise sets the joint positions of each waypoint
command_arm calls command_arm_trajectory with one waypoint and its timeout as the time from start
The upstream executor calls command_arm with timeout=1.0
Controller defines the seven arm joints of each arm, the four finger joints of each gripper, the torso lift joint and the two head joints
get_arm_positions returns get_joint_positions of the arm's joint names
PR2_JOINT_SAFETY_LIMITS lists the PR2 safety_controller soft limits taken from the PR2 URDF
The PR2 URDF declares r_forearm_roll_joint and r_wrist_roll_joint continuous
The PR2 URDF declares l_forearm_roll_joint and l_wrist_roll_joint continuous
The upstream's simulation runner sets execute_motor_control true and enables gravity before it executes a plan

determinism.notes: the fake has no randomness; its start pose is placeholder data

fidelity.engine: analytic: in-memory PBController stand-in (no PyBullet, no physics)
gaps: the fake is an in-memory stand-in for PBController, not PyBullet: no collisions, joint limits of the URDF, gravity, attachments or perception
the package has no sim backend: building ROSWorld(sim_only=True) needs pybullet, the ss-pybullet submodule (pybullet_tools) and the PR2 model files, none of which the gate loads
the start pose of the fake is placeholder data, not the URDF's zero configuration
only the arms and the torso are served; grippers, head, attachments, perception and plan execution are not
commands are refused when execute_motor_control is true (motor control steps the physics inside the call and cannot be stopped)

measures.description: Left then right arm joint angles in Controller.LEFT_ARM, RIGHT_ARM order

safe_state.description: no command after the latch and PBController.execute_motor_control false (set and read back by the e-stop): with real-time simulation off (ros_world.py:27) and commands that set joint positions kinematically (pb_controller.py:103-148), nothing this endpoint calls advances the simulated PR2 after the latch (another holder of the same world could)
